title: Self-training Cyclotron: shadow mode on Threat Intelligence

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Ryan 2026-10-18 20:10Z asked for one site-wide cyclotron with a classifier per Section plus a Section selector. Tracked in epic PPY-0a285b53-456c-46a3-b179-a9898f3d67ec (kanbus does not allow an epic under an epic). It reuses this epic's human-only labels, shadow mode and proof gate.

right_now_summary: The team is building a human-approved shadow test with audit logs, safeguards, and a second publication trial.
